description: Horaires et plans du réseau STAR au format PDF is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des plans et horaires des lignes de bus et métro du réseau STAR disponibles au téléchargement au format PDF. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are star, plan, horaires, pdf, document, information. The portal shows 862 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2015-07-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-ND (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
